messages.text: How do changes in AI data centers technology affect the measurement capability required from Signaling / Non-signaling Tester?

Short answer: the passages support a shift toward higher-speed connectivity, power/thermal infrastructure, resilience, high-speed interconnects, and production-oriented wireless validation in AI data-center contexts, but they directly document implications mainly for CMX500 and CMP180, not CMW or CMP200 [36][45][51].
### AI data-center technology signals
AI data-center infrastructure is described around Connectivity, Power, and Resilience [45].
Data-center solution components include Power Management, Rack & Accessories, Management System, Precision Cooling, and Service [45].
The AI data-center eco-chain taxonomy lists AI Chips as GPU/ASIC, CPU, Switch, and PCIE/Serdes [36].
The same taxonomy lists Components as PCB, Cable/Connector, Optical module, and Power Supply [36].
A data-center ecosystem map lists Peripheral categories including Power, PMIC, PCB, HS connection, Optical Module, and Switch [51].
### High-speed interfaces and signal-integrity implications
CMX500 can use the R&S CMX-B200A accelerator unit with two full-duplex high-speed digital I/Q interfaces on QSFP+ at 40 Gbps [8].
CMX500 can use the R&S CMX-B300C processing unit with a LAN DAU QSFP+ interface supporting 1 Gbps, 10 Gbps, and 40 Gbps [11].
R&S PCB test solutions list high-speed PCB-related measurements including TDR impedance, DK/DF extraction, insertion loss, roughness, crosstalk, transmission-line modeling, and eye diagram [54].
【推論】Because AI data-center sources name PCIE/SerDes, PCB, cable/connector, optical module, HS connection, and switch, signaling/non-signaling tester planning should account for high-speed digital I/O and adjacent SI/PCB validation rather than only RF behavior.[36][51][8][11][54]
### Wireless connectivity implications
Wi-Fi 7 is described as targeting extremely high data throughput, tens of gigabits per second, low latency, UHD video streaming, VR, and AR [4].
Wi-Fi 7 key throughput elements include 320 MHz channel bandwidth, up to 16 spatial streams, 4096 QAM, and MLO [4].
CMX500 is described as a multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester with integrated Wi-Fi 7 test functionality [1].
CMX500 Wi-Fi 7 R&D testing is described in signaling mode under real-world conditions for RF TX/RX characteristics [1].
CMX500 Wi-Fi 7 test scenarios include MLO, multiple RF chains, 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery, coexistence, and E2E test capabilities [1].
CMX500 supports NR FR1/FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling and measurements, WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, PER measurement, application test, IP traffic analysis, IMS, audio, and POLQA [7].
CMX500 is also described for WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN through an integrated N3IWF gateway and integrated POLQA voice quality measurement [5].
CMP180 supports Wi-Fi 6E, Wi-Fi 7, and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz with bandwidths up to 500 MHz [2].
CMP180 is described as demonstrating loopback verification of a 480 MHz WLAN waveform, which the source calls a potential waveform candidate for yet-to-be-defined Wi-Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn [2].
【推論】Because AI data-center sources emphasize Connectivity and Wi-Fi 7 raises bandwidth, MIMO, modulation, and MLO demands, signaling testers such as CMX500 need multi-technology, multi-channel, cellular/WLAN, MLO/MIMO, coexistence, throughput, PER, and E2E coverage.[45][4][1][7]
### Synchronization implications
CMX500 has a high-performance OCXO timebase with maximum frequency drift of ±5 × 10^-9 from 0 °C to +50 °C referenced to +25 °C [12].
CMX500 has a 10 MHz rear-panel reference input with ±7.5 × 10^-7 lock-in range and a 10 MHz reference output [12].
CMP180 has a high-performance OCXO timebase with maximum frequency drift of ±5 × 10^-9 from 0 °C to +50 °C referenced to +25 °C [29].
CMP180 has a 10 MHz rear-panel reference input with ±7.5 × 10^-7 lock-in range and a 10 MHz reference output [29].
Two CMP180 instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for 4x4 MIMO access-point testing [2].
The source does not provide CMP180 multi-instrument synchronization architecture, cabling, software option, calibration method, or timing/phase-coherence specification [26].
### Power and thermal implications
AI data-center infrastructure sources list Power as a core dimension [45].
Data-center solution components include Power Management and Precision Cooling [45].
CMX500 Callbox application and mobility use cases include Power Consumption [19].
The CMX500 energy-efficiency test solution supports seamless power-consumption measurements in parallel with RF measurements, protocol tests, or application tests [66].
CMX500 general specifications list operating temperature from +5 °C to +45 °C, storage temperature from –25 °C to +60 °C, and damp heat at +40 °C and 80 % relative humidity [14].
### EMI/EMC implications
CMX500 conformity includes EU EMC Directive 2014/30/EU, EN 61326-1 industrial environment, and EN 55011 class A [14].
CMP180 conformity includes EU EMC Directive 2014/30/EU, EN 61326-1 industrial environment, and EN 55011 class A [30].
These passages support EMC conformity for CMX500 and CMP180, but they do not state that either instrument is an EMI/EMC measurement receiver or compliance-test system [14][30].
### Production test implications
In WLAN device production, all RF measurements are performed in non-signaling mode to save time [2].
CMP180 is positioned as the radio communication tester optimized for WLAN production non-signaling RF testing [2].
CMP180 integrates two analyzers, two generators, and two sets of eight RF ports for single-box 2x2 MIMO testing [2].
Two CMP180 instruments can be combined for four analyzers and generators for efficient 4x4 MIMO access-point testing [2].
CMP180 RF unit R&S CMP-B802x supports 250 MHz bandwidth [31].
CMP180 RF unit R&S CMP-B805x supports 250 MHz bandwidth and can use R&S CMP-K185 to enable 500 MHz [31].
CMP180 measurement options include R&S CMP-KM352 for WLAN IEEE 802.11be SISO measurements [32].
CMP180 measurement options include R&S CMP-KM360 for WLAN true MIMO 2x2 and 4x4 measurements [32].
CMP180 measurement options include R&S CMP-KM361 for WLAN true MIMO 5x5 and 6x6 measurements [32].
CMP180 measurement options include R&S CMP-KM365 for WLAN packet error rate acknowledgement measurements [32].
CMP180 waveform options include R&S CMP-KV352 for WLAN IEEE 802.11be waveforms [33].
CMP180 selected WLAN IEEE 802.11be analyzer performance includes 160 MHz and 320 MHz entries, including improved listed values with R&S CMP-KB805 [35].
CMP180 selected WLAN IEEE 802.11be generator performance includes 160 MHz and 320 MHz entries [35].
【推論】Because AI data-center sources point to high-speed connectivity, power infrastructure, and production ecosystems, non-signaling production testers should emphasize fast non-signaling RF, wide bandwidth, scalable MIMO, reference synchronization, and industrial EMC-conformant deployment.[36][45][51][2][29][30]
### Product-specific implications
CMX500 is supported in the passages as the R&D signaling and interworking tester for Wi-Fi 7, cellular/WLAN operation, RF TX/RX under signaling mode, WLAN offloading, Voice over WLAN, N3IWF, and POLQA [1][3][5].
CMX500 is also supported as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement solution for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD [7].
CMP180 is supported in the passages as the production non-signaling RF tester for Wi-Fi 7 and related WLAN production workflows [2][3].
CMP180 is also supported as a configurable radio communication tester with multi-port RF generator/analyzer hardware, measurement options, waveform options, and R&S VSE analysis capability [28].

passages.text:
Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 中描述的測試方案組合：以 [[R&S CMX500]] 覆蓋 R&D signaling / interworking 測試，以 [[R&S CMP180]] 覆蓋 production non-signaling RF 測試。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Wi-Fi 7 技術挑戰
來源將 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] 描述為 designed for extremely high data throughput，面向 tens of gigabits per second、low latency、ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality applications。來源列出的 higher throughput key elements：

| 技術項目 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| channel bandwidth | increased channel bandwidth of 320 MHz |
| spatial streams | up to 16 spatial streams |
| modulation | 4096 QAM modulation |
| MLO | key feature；使 multiple RF chains 測試環境變重要 |

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Interworking：WLAN offloading 與 Voice over WLAN
同一來源也把 [[R&S CMX500]] 用於 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 seamless traffic offloading and interworking demonstration：

- [[WLAN offloading]] 是把原本 intended for cellular networks 的 data 透過 WLAN 傳送，以減少 cellular bands data load。
- [[Voice over WLAN]] 情境聚焦在 cellular network 與 WLAN 之間 handover during a voice call，以維持 uninterrupted voice call experience。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 內建 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway，可測試 WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement function 可用於 voice over WLAN applications 的 quality of experience early-stage 評估。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › 使用限制
- 本頁目前只由 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 支撐。
- 來源是 PR / demonstration positioning，不是正式 datasheet、configuration guide、test case list 或 certification document。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[R&S CMX500]] Wi‑Fi 7 的 option code、software release、支援 RF chains 數量、MLO link combination、measurement uncertainty 或完整 test coverage。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[R&S CMP180]] 480 MHz waveform 的正式 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 標準地位、量測規格或 production throughput。

Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024 › 重點摘要
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 將在 [[MWC 2024]] 展示最新 [[Wi-Fi 7]] R&D 與 production 測試方案，用於應對 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]]、[[LTE]] 與 [[5G]] parallel operation 的測試挑戰。

- [[R&S CMX500]] 的 Wi‑Fi 7 R&D 測試情境包含 signaling mode、real-world RF TX/RX characteristics、[[MLO]]、multiple RF chains、2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 也被用於展示 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 traffic offloading / interworking；來源稱其 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway 可測試 [[WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN]]，並搭配 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被描述為 production phase 的 non-signaling RF measurement tester，支援 cellular 與 non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將在 MWC 展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform；來源稱這是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 來源說法：two analyzers、two generators、two sets of eight RF ports integrated，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing；兩台 CMP180 可 combined / scaled，支援 four analyzers and generators，用於 4x4 MIMO access points。
- 展示地點：Fira Gran Via, Barcelona，hall 5，booth 5A80。
- Press & media contact：[[Christian Mokry]]，PR Manager Test & measurement。
- 公司段落稱 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 在 2024/2025 fiscal year（July to June）net revenue 為 EUR 3.16 billion，且 2025-06-30 有 more than 15,000 employees worldwide。

- **Material/Stackup selection**：IL、DK/DF、roughness、impedance、Xtalk、TL modeling、Eye diagram。
- **Signal Integrity modeling/testing**：IL、DK/DF、roughness、impedance。
- **Sampling testing**：IL、DK/DF、impedance。
- **PL/Process Monitoring**：來源列在同一流程上，但未展開 PL。
- 圖上另列 [[SPEAG]]、[[SWISSTO12]]、[[QWED]]、[[KEYCOM]]、[[RSTW]]、TDR、Delta-L、ISD/ADK、ISD/ADK、w/ cable / connector testing 等文字。

answer.text:
Short answer: the passages support a shift toward higher-speed connectivity, power/thermal infrastructure, resilience, high-speed interconnects, and production-oriented wireless validation in AI data-center contexts, but they directly document implications mainly for CMX500 and CMP180, not CMW or CMP200 [36][45][51].
### AI data-center technology signals
AI data-center infrastructure is described around Connectivity, Power, and Resilience [45].
Data-center solution components include Power Management, Rack & Accessories, Management System, Precision Cooling, and Service [45].
The AI data-center eco-chain taxonomy lists AI Chips as GPU/ASIC, CPU, Switch, and PCIE/Serdes [36].
The same taxonomy lists Components as PCB, Cable/Connector, Optical module, and Power Supply [36].
A data-center ecosystem map lists Peripheral categories including Power, PMIC, PCB, HS connection, Optical Module, and Switch [51].
### High-speed interfaces and signal-integrity implications
CMX500 can use the R&S CMX-B200A accelerator unit with two full-duplex high-speed digital I/Q interfaces on QSFP+ at 40 Gbps [8].
CMX500 can use the R&S CMX-B300C processing unit with a LAN DAU QSFP+ interface supporting 1 Gbps, 10 Gbps, and 40 Gbps [11].
R&S PCB test solutions list high-speed PCB-related measurements including TDR impedance, DK/DF extraction, insertion loss, roughness, crosstalk, transmission-line modeling, and eye diagram [54].
【推論】Because AI data-center sources name PCIE/SerDes, PCB, cable/connector, optical module, HS connection, and switch, signaling/non-signaling tester planning should account for high-speed digital I/O and adjacent SI/PCB validation rather than only RF behavior.[36][51][8][11][54]
### Wireless connectivity implications
Wi-Fi 7 is described as targeting extremely high data throughput, tens of gigabits per second, low latency, UHD video streaming, VR, and AR [4].
Wi-Fi 7 key throughput elements include 320 MHz channel bandwidth, up to 16 spatial streams, 4096 QAM, and MLO [4].
CMX500 is described as a multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester with integrated Wi-Fi 7 test functionality [1].
CMX500 Wi-Fi 7 R&D testing is described in signaling mode under real-world conditions for RF TX/RX characteristics [1].
CMX500 Wi-Fi 7 test scenarios include MLO, multiple RF chains, 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery, coexistence, and E2E test capabilities [1].
CMX500 supports NR FR1/FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling and measurements, WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, PER measurement, application test, IP traffic analysis, IMS, audio, and POLQA [7].
CMX500 is also described for WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN through an integrated N3IWF gateway and integrated POLQA voice quality measurement [5].
CMP180 supports Wi-Fi 6E, Wi-Fi 7, and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz with bandwidths up to 500 MHz [2].
CMP180 is described as demonstrating loopback verification of a 480 MHz WLAN waveform, which the source calls a potential waveform candidate for yet-to-be-defined Wi-Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn [2].
【推論】Because AI data-center sources emphasize Connectivity and Wi-Fi 7 raises bandwidth, MIMO, modulation, and MLO demands, signaling testers such as CMX500 need multi-technology, multi-channel, cellular/WLAN, MLO/MIMO, coexistence, throughput, PER, and E2E coverage.[45][4][1][7]
### Synchronization implications
CMX500 has a high-performance OCXO timebase with maximum frequency drift of ±5 × 10^-9 from 0 °C to +50 °C referenced to +25 °C [12].
CMX500 has a 10 MHz rear-panel reference input with ±7.5 × 10^-7 lock-in range and a 10 MHz reference output [12].
CMP180 has a high-performance OCXO timebase with maximum frequency drift of ±5 × 10^-9 from 0 °C to +50 °C referenced to +25 °C [29].
CMP180 has a 10 MHz rear-panel reference input with ±7.5 × 10^-7 lock-in range and a 10 MHz reference output [29].
Two CMP180 instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for 4x4 MIMO access-point testing [2].
The source does not provide CMP180 multi-instrument synchronization architecture, cabling, software option, calibration method, or timing/phase-coherence specification [26].
### Power and thermal implications
AI data-center infrastructure sources list Power as a core dimension [45].
Data-center solution components include Power Management and Precision Cooling [45].
CMX500 Callbox application and mobility use cases include Power Consumption [19].
The CMX500 energy-efficiency test solution supports seamless power-consumption measurements in parallel with RF measurements, protocol tests, or application tests [66].
CMX500 general specifications list operating temperature from +5 °C to +45 °C, storage temperature from –25 °C to +60 °C, and damp heat at +40 °C and 80 % relative humidity [14].
### EMI/EMC implications
CMX500 conformity includes EU EMC Directive 2014/30/EU, EN 61326-1 industrial environment, and EN 55011 class A [14].
CMP180 conformity includes EU EMC Directive 2014/30/EU, EN 61326-1 industrial environment, and EN 55011 class A [30].
These passages support EMC conformity for CMX500 and CMP180, but they do not state that either instrument is an EMI/EMC measurement receiver or compliance-test system [14][30].
### Production test implications
In WLAN device production, all RF measurements are performed in non-signaling mode to save time [2].
CMP180 is positioned as the radio communication tester optimized for WLAN production non-signaling RF testing [2].
CMP180 integrates two analyzers, two generators, and two sets of eight RF ports for single-box 2x2 MIMO testing [2].
Two CMP180 instruments can be combined for four analyzers and generators for efficient 4x4 MIMO access-point testing [2].
CMP180 RF unit R&S CMP-B802x supports 250 MHz bandwidth [31].
CMP180 RF unit R&S CMP-B805x supports 250 MHz bandwidth and can use R&S CMP-K185 to enable 500 MHz [31].
CMP180 measurement options include R&S CMP-KM352 for WLAN IEEE 802.11be SISO measurements [32].
CMP180 measurement options include R&S CMP-KM360 for WLAN true MIMO 2x2 and 4x4 measurements [32].
CMP180 measurement options include R&S CMP-KM361 for WLAN true MIMO 5x5 and 6x6 measurements [32].
CMP180 measurement options include R&S CMP-KM365 for WLAN packet error rate acknowledgement measurements [32].
CMP180 waveform options include R&S CMP-KV352 for WLAN IEEE 802.11be waveforms [33].
CMP180 selected WLAN IEEE 802.11be analyzer performance includes 160 MHz and 320 MHz entries, including improved listed values with R&S CMP-KB805 [35].
CMP180 selected WLAN IEEE 802.11be generator performance includes 160 MHz and 320 MHz entries [35].
【推論】Because AI data-center sources point to high-speed connectivity, power infrastructure, and production ecosystems, non-signaling production testers should emphasize fast non-signaling RF, wide bandwidth, scalable MIMO, reference synchronization, and industrial EMC-conformant deployment.[36][45][51][2][29][30]
### Product-specific implications
CMX500 is supported in the passages as the R&D signaling and interworking tester for Wi-Fi 7, cellular/WLAN operation, RF TX/RX under signaling mode, WLAN offloading, Voice over WLAN, N3IWF, and POLQA [1][3][5].
CMX500 is also supported as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement solution for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD [7].
CMP180 is supported in the passages as the production non-signaling RF tester for Wi-Fi 7 and related WLAN production workflows [2][3].
CMP180 is also supported as a configurable radio communication tester with multi-port RF generator/analyzer hardware, measurement options, waveform options, and R&S VSE analysis capability [28].

R&S PCB test solutions › 來源中的說法
[[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]]（封面日期 2026.3.4）Slide 21 題為 **R&S PCB test solutions**，副標為 **PCB Fabricator and System House**，列出以下流程與項目：

- **Material Measurement**：Impedance ([[TDR]])、DK/DF extraction。
- **Material/Stackup selection**：IL、DK/DF、roughness、impedance、Xtalk、TL modeling、Eye diagram。
- **Signal Integrity modeling/testing**：IL、DK/DF、roughness、impedance。
- **Sampling testing**：IL、DK/DF、impedance。
- **PL/Process Monitoring**：來源列在同一流程上，但未展開 PL。
- 圖上另列 [[SPEAG]]、[[SWISSTO12]]、[[QWED]]、[[KEYCOM]]、[[RSTW]]、TDR、Delta-L、ISD/ADK、ISD/ADK、w/ cable / connector testing 等文字。

To address future test requirements, SmartViser and Rohde & Schwarz have paired up and combined their solutions. The [R&S CMX500](https://www.rohde-schwarz.com/us/products/test-and-measurement/wireless-tester-network-emulator/cmx500-5g-one-box-signaling-tester_63493-601282.html "CMX500") wireless communication tester supports the latest wireless technologies, including LTE, 5G NR and WLAN. Its energy efficiency test solution offers seamless power consumption measurements in parallel to RF measurements, protocol tests or application tests.
